schedulesPage.finePrint: A schedule is set here and only here; a plugin instance shows its schedules and links back. Inputs and list generators have none: they run when somebody uses them. Intention repeats are listed so everything that happens by itself is in one place; what they make is defined on Intentions.
schedulesPage.repeatSource: Intention repeat · makes the next occurrence
schedulesPage.timelineFinePrint: A dot is one run. A lane that runs more often than it can show is drawn as a band.
